source_text: Uxorem virginem de populo suo accipiat. Ecclesia virgo casta Christo. Non vidua haeresum.
pass_a_gloss: Wife virgin from people his let-him-take. Church virgin chaste to-Christ. Not widow of-heresies.
pass_b_english: He shall take a [[virgin wife from his people >> Bible:Leviticus 21:13-14]]. The church is a chaste virgin for Christ — not heresy’s widow.
